name: Configuration Engineer
description: Administers configuration management across the Technology & Engineering value stream, governing the CMDB, onboarding new systems as configuration items, and running quarterly accuracy audits. Provisions environments from infrastructure-as-code templates, executes patch deployments to production, and detects configuration drift, while reconciling installed software against license entitlements and managing credentials and secrets under control.

name: Consumer Affairs Analyst
description: Performs formal complaint intake, investigation, and resolution within the Call Center value stream, assessing complaint merits and determining resolution actions within authority. Produces complaint analytics and root-cause analysis, identifying recurring failure patterns and preparing quarterly trend reports. Tracks regulatory acknowledgment deadlines and coordinates corrective actions and process changes with operations.

name: Consumer Affairs Manager
description: Leads complaint resolution and producer complaint handling for the Call Center, finalizing resolution determinations and confirming corrective actions are completed. Oversees complaint analytics, comparing complaint ratios per 1,000 policies against benchmarks, and directs regulatory reporting to response standards. Flags bad-faith or litigation-risk complaints and coordinates investigation findings for disciplinary review.

name: Contact Center Agent
description: Performs service inquiry resolution across the Call Center value stream, handling contact intake, escalated digital sessions, and producer policy-servicing inquiries while routing claims-related contacts to intake. Supports service quality monitoring by analyzing aggregate quality data for systemic issues, closing the loop with dissatisfied customers, and contributing to defined service improvement actions.

name: Contact Center Ops Manager
description: Oversees complaint resolution operations in the Call Center, finalizing resolution determinations, confirming corrective actions, and applying regulatory response standards to complaint correspondence. Manages complaint analytics, benchmarking complaint ratios per 1,000 policies, and handles producer complaint escalations — suspending producer transaction authority during investigations and filing regulatory notifications for terminated-for-cause producers.

name: Contact Center Supervisor
description: Coordinates formal complaint intake, investigation, and resolution within the Call Center, confirming specialist assignments, establishing resolution target dates, and finalizing determinations. Monitors complaint analytics and ratio benchmarks, drafts response letters to regulatory standards, and escalates bad-faith or litigation-risk complaints, routing investigation findings into disciplinary review and corrective action.

name: Content Specialist
description: Produces creative content assets for channel marketing campaigns across the Sales, Distribution & Marketing value stream, planning editorial calendars and developing co-branded campaign materials. Manages social media reporting and SEO operations, routes content through compliance and brand review, and audits external materials against codified brand guidelines while forecasting campaign reach and ROI.

name: Contract Administrator
description: Administers contract financial obligations and legal entity records within Legal & Corporate Governance, supporting board meeting planning, secretarial filings, and regulatory filing management. Maintains director fee and equity award records, coordinates director payments with Finance and HR, and obtains business-unit sign-off on commercial terms. Supports political contributions compliance and vendor data-processing governance.

name: Contracts Manager
description: Leads contract financial obligations management within Legal & Corporate Governance, negotiating commercial terms and securing business-unit sign-off across finance, operations, and claims matters. Oversees regulatory filing management, responding to regulator objection letters and negotiating resolutions with the DOI, while supporting secretarial filings, board governance records, and political contributions compliance reporting.

name: Controller
description: Owns financial statement preparation and reserve reporting across the Finance & Investments value stream, calculating actuarial liability balances and preparing statutory reserve schedules. Manages capital instruments and share repurchase program accounting, supports financial examinations and M&A financial due diligence, and reconciles claims and ALAE data against accruals to close costs with a complete audit record.

name: Controls Analyst
description: Performs operational, regulatory, and IT general controls testing across the Risk, Compliance & Audit value stream, executing assurance programme plans approved by the Compliance Committee. Manages control deficiencies end to end — logging failures, validating closure evidence, re-testing remediated controls, and reporting deficiency inventory and closure metrics — while reconciling control ownership against the HR org structure.

name: Corporate Development Manager
description: Leads corporate development activity within the Executive Office's Corporate Strategy & Development function, evaluating acquisition, partnership, and investment opportunities that advance enterprise strategy. Coordinates deal analysis and stakeholder alignment across finance, legal, and business leadership.

name: Corporate Secretary
description: Owns corporate governance and secretarial filings within Legal & Corporate Governance, maintaining board composition records and reporting director changes to regulators. Manages regulatory filing and Holding Company Act compliance, negotiating with the DOI to resolve objection letters, and oversees defense management by monitoring court deadlines and case reviews with counsel, alongside legal operations metrics and PAC reporting.
